incidents.title: Olive prior-auth API latency increasing
incidents.signal: p95 API latency on olive-authsvc rose from 240ms → 1,180ms over 6 hours. EDI 278 prior-auth intake queue backing up at 2,300 msg/min against a 1,850 drain rate.
analysis: Connection pool saturation on PG-OLIVE-PRD-02 (198/200 in use).
Correlates with the nightly prior-auth reconciliation job, which overran its window by 47 min.
Same signature as INC0102117 (14 May) — resolved by pool resize + job reschedule.
incidents.businessImpact: Prior-auth decisioning throughput down ~34%. If sustained past 11:15 this breaches the 4-hour P2 restore SLA and delays roughly 18,000 authorization requests.
incidents.recommendation: Approve pre-staged automation RB-OLV-014: raise pool to 320, rolling recycle of app nodes, reschedule the recon job to 01:00.

note.text: Blast radius: 2 of 6 app nodes at a time. Estimated member-facing impact: none. Rollback: 90 seconds.

incidents.title: Backup validation overdue — Olive claims DB
incidents.signal: Restore-verification job for OLIVE-CLAIMS-DB has not completed a successful integrity check in 26 hours (policy: every 24h).
analysis: Last full backup succeeded at 02:10; the verification worker pool was exhausted by concurrent Solera data-lake jobs.
No data-loss risk detected — this is a verification gap, not a backup failure.
incidents.businessImpact: Contingency-plan evidence under HIPAA §164.308(a)(7) requires demonstrable restore testing. A gap beyond 48h becomes an audit finding against the GuideWell service contract.
incidents.recommendation: Launch off-peak verification into the isolated recovery VLAN and pin worker priority above the Solera batch.

note.text: Compliance evidence gap — not data loss. Closes on successful verification.

incidents.title: Storage consumption trend exceeds threshold — Solera Tier-1
incidents.signal: Solera care/claims data platform Tier-1 storage at 88.4%, growing 1.9 TB/week against 46 TB free.
analysis: 90% threshold crossed in ~6 days; hard-full in ~21 days.
Driver: new care-program cohort onboarded 12 July (+38% claims-event volume into Solera).
2.1 TB reclaimable from orphaned snapshots and expired extract cache.
incidents.businessImpact: Options — Now: reclaim 2.1 TB (buys ~8 days), zero risk, automated. Short term: tier 14 TB of extracts older than 18 months to Azure archive. Structural: expansion shelf, 12-week vendor lead time, needs a PO.
incidents.recommendation: Run the reclaim today and start the expansion PO in parallel.

incidents.title: RJ Health drug-pricing feed queue depth rising
incidents.signal: Inbound NDC pricing-update queue on RJH-FEED-01 at 8,412 messages (normal < 900).
analysis: The feed processor is healthy; the downstream Pricing Reference API is returning intermittent 503s (7.2% error rate).
The consumer is the bottleneck, not the ingest.
incidents.businessImpact: Drug price updates lagging ~11 minutes into the pricing reference store. Not yet materially affecting claim adjudication, but escalates past 30 min — stale pricing risks incorrect member cost share.
incidents.recommendation: Scale the Pricing Reference API from 6 → 10 pods and enable the circuit breaker. Pre-approved standard change.

incidents.title: 2 changes awaiting CAB validation before 14:00
incidents.signal: Two RFCs need validation before the 14:00 CAB.
analysis: CHG0032118 — Quarterly firmware uplift on 6 core switches, DC-East. Risk: Medium. Window Sat 02:00–06:00.
CHG0032124 — Windows Server July cumulative patch, 214 servers including 22 in the Olive production tier.
Both have complete rollback plans and validated test evidence.
CHG0032124 conflicts with the Olive release freeze covering those 22 servers — agent recommends splitting the wave.
incidents.businessImpact: Missing the CAB pushes both changes a week and holds 22 servers out of patch compliance.
incidents.recommendation: Approve CHG0032118 and split the CHG0032124 wave to exclude frozen Olive servers.

incidents.title: Patch compliance below target — 91.3% vs 95%
incidents.signal: 91.3% compliant across 726 servers. 63 non-compliant, of which 11 carry critical CVEs.
analysis: 22 servers held under the Olive release freeze (expires 2 Aug).
19 awaiting reboot window — patched but not activated.
14 legacy Server 2012 R2 — remediation plan in flight.
8 genuine failures — agent has drafted retry jobs.
incidents.businessImpact: The contractual security KPI is 95% within 30 days of release. Currently amber for the July service review.
incidents.recommendation: Approve the 8 retry jobs and book a reboot wave — that alone reaches 95.1%.

note.text: 11 servers carry critical CVEs and are the priority within the 63.

incidents.title: High incident recurrence — Citrix logon storms
incidents.signal: 9 incidents in 14 days, all between 07:00–07:45, all logon latency >45s on Citrix Farm B — the farm serving Care Navigator care managers and member service advocates.
analysis: Profile-load contention against the FSLogix share; the storage IOPS ceiling is hit at 6,200 concurrent logons.
Restarting session hosts resolves the symptom, not the cause — a classic problem-management candidate.
incidents.businessImpact: ~2,700 advocate-minutes lost per incident. Across 9 incidents that is roughly 405 hours of care-team and service-centre productivity.
incidents.recommendation: Create a Problem Record with the pre-drafted RCA and the FSLogix cloud-cache remediation plan.
